newsitem.title: UK: KfW eyes seven-year sterling Eurobond - traders.
newsitem.headline: KfW eyes seven-year sterling Eurobond - traders.

text.p: Kreditanstalt fuer Wiederaufbau (KfW) may launch a seven-year sterling Eurobond next week, dealers said on Thursday.
Issue size was likely between 150 million stg and 200 million stg, and spread talk was 15 basis points over gilts.
"KfW is talking to banks, but no decision has been taken yet," said a syndicate head at a British bank.
"A deal is not expected tomorrow, but remains a strong possibility for next week. KfW's funding target is quite difficult to meet at the moment, but the market may move slightly," he said.
On Wednesday Sweden launched a 300 million stg seven-year bond which the market snapped up.
Launched at 20 b.p. over gilts, the spread remained at that level today, dealers said.
"The success of Sweden showed the sterling market is open, and everyone is now looking to see what they can do," said a trader at another British bank.
"KfW is one of the most likely names, though," he added.
